text:
laura_cs: Quick capture from three onboarding calls this week — collecting product asks + friction signals. Pasting the raw bullets so PMs/eng can triage.

laura_cs: 1) Customers want permission-scoped API keys (team-level keys + usage breakdown by key). repeated ask from two pilots.
laura_cs: 2) New users confused by 'default model fallback' — want explicit UI + docs saying when we fall back to smaller variants.
laura_cs: 3) Several asks for an exportable usage CSV filtered by date + route (support wants this for monthly invoices).
laura_cs: 4) One account reported flaky batch retries: jobs sometimes 500->requeue loop, they want a configurable retry/backoff policy.
laura_cs: 5) Onboarding note: they asked for a short checklist or playbook to hand devs for token/permission setup.

laura_cs: @mike_pm tagging you for prioritization — also flagging renewal risk for AcmeHealth (billing confusion + missing per-team metrics). :warning:

mike_pm: thanks laura — can you add severity (low/med/high) and whether it's blocking renewal? quick answers OK.

laura_cs: quick severity tags: 1) API keys = high (blocks multi-team rollout), 2) fallback docs = medium, 3) export CSV = medium, 4) batch retry = high (production reliability), 5) checklist = low. AcmeHealth: high risk if not resolved before next invoice.

devon_prod: got it. csv export + checklist feel like quick wins. I can scope CSV export and UI filter this sprint if engineering bandwidth allows. ETA: prototype by end of next week.

ashley_research: can you paste sample transcripts or screenshots where they stumble on the fallback behavior? I want concrete prompts/UX snippets for the docs + in-product messaging.

laura_cs: pasted a short convo below from AcmeHealth call:
laura_cs: "Dev: we thought requests were using the bigger model but results were different. Ops: we had to dig through logs to prove fallback happened. Can we surface that in the console?"

jordan_se: for the API keys ask — is this purely an API/console feature or also needs backend work (billing attribution)? I can help map to billing.

laura_cs: both. They want keys scoped to teams so billing shows per-team usage. Also want role-based key creation (admin vs dev).

devon_prod: ok. Proposed triage:
- High: permission-scoped API keys (requires billing + auth work) -> create ticket, spike to estimate (owner: @devon_prod).
- High: batch retry/backoff -> engineering investigate logs, add backoff config (owner: @devon_prod).
- Medium: export CSV -> quick UI + backend endpoint (owner: @devon_prod).
- Medium: fallback visibility -> docs + small console flag showing active model (owner: @mike_pm for docs, @devon_prod for console).
- Low: onboarding checklist -> CS to draft, PD to review (owner: @laura_cs).

devon_prod: I'll open the tickets today and link to this thread.

mike_pm: thanks. Ashley — can you draft an evaluation checklist for fallback UX so we can run a short QA pass?

ashley_research: yes — will add concrete test prompts + expected behavior. aiming to drop a doc in the product repo by Wed.

onboarding_bot: Template created: https://internal.redwood.ai/templates/cs-feedback-capture — includes fields for severity, renewal_risk, sample_transcript, suggested_workaround.

laura_cs: perfect, I'll fill the template for AcmeHealth and attach screenshots.

jordan_se: tagging billing team FYI — they may need to surface per-team breakdown in the upcoming invoice export. @billing_team

mike_pm: summary: Devon to spike API keys + retry fix; prototype CSV this sprint if possible; Ashley to prepare test checklist; Laura to fill template for AcmeHealth. Please add any objections. :thumbsup:

laura_cs: no objections. thanks everyone — will follow up once AcmeHealth template is uploaded.
